meta.title: Grok Bot
meta.description: A sponsor-free Grok Bot directory. Install setup text, then paste it into Grok Bot.

home.title: Bots and teams you can install
home.lead: A listing is a specialist or a team you install into Grok Bot. Install copies the setup text so you can paste it into Grok Bot. A team has a chief plus specialists.
home.search: Search by name, summary, or plugin
home.emptyHint: Try another search or reset the filters.
home.demoBanner: Supabase env vars are missing, so this catalog is loaded from the committed seed file. You can still browse every listing.

bot.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard. Check browser permission.
bot.pasteHint: Paste this into Grok Bot setup. It should ask what to connect, then save itself.

submit.title: Submit a bot
submit.lead: Fill markdown-like fields and publish it yourself. v1 has no review board.
submit.needAuth: Sign in to save a listing.
submit.demoHint: Auth and the database are not configured in this environment. You can still install setup text; saving needs Supabase and Better Auth.
submit.name: Name
submit.slugHint: Used in the URL. Korean names are romanized. Lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens.
submit.promptHint: Include role, what it owns, what good looks like, what it must never do without asking, and a first task.

fromLink.title: Draft setup text from a link
fromLink.lead: Paste a public URL. v1 pulls the title and text into a fixed template. No paid LLM key required.
fromLink.fetched: Page read. Edit the draft below, then install or submit it.
fromLink.fetchFailed: Could not fetch that page. Check the URL, or fill the form yourself.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.lead: Use GitHub or Google to submit listings.
signIn.missing: Local demo mode. Set these env vars to enable social login.

footer.note: No ads, affiliates, or sponsor rails. Write and share setup text yourself.
footer.license: Listings are free to copy and adapt.

a11y.copyAll: Install every setup text on the {name} team
